stones.Yellow Sapphire: Yellow Sapphire (Pukhraj) should be worn in the right hand index finger, set in gold, with the stone’s weight calculated as Ratti = body weight/10. It must be worn on a Thursday of Shukla Paksha, by chanting its Beej Mantra “ॐ ग्रां ग्रीं ग्रौं सः गुरवे नमः.” 108 times.
stones.Blue Sapphire: Blue Sapphire should be worn in the right hand middle finger, with the stone’s weight calculated as Ratti = body weight/10. It can be worn in gold or silver. The gemstone must be worn on a Saturday of Shukla Paksha, by chanting its Beej Mantra “ॐ प्रां प्रीं प्रौं सः शनैश्चराय नमः.” 108 times.
stones.Hessonite: Gomed should be worn on the right hand middle finger, with its weight calculated as Ratti = body weight/10. It must be worn in silver. The ideal day to wear this gemstone is Tuesday or Saturday of Shukla Paksha, by chanting its Beej Mantra “ॐ भ्रां भ्रीं भ्रौं सः राहवे नमः.” 108 times
stones.Cat’s Eye: Cat’s Eye should be worn on the right hand middle finger, with the stone’s weight calculated as Ratti = body Weight/10. It must be worn in silver. The ideal day to wear this gemstone is Tuesday of Shukla Paksha, by chanting its Beej Mantra “ॐ स्रां स्रीं स्रौं सः केतवे नमः.” 108 times
stones.Ruby: Ruby should be worn on the right hand ring finger, with its weight calculated as Ratti = Body Weight/10. It can be worn in copper or gold. The gemstone must be worn on a Sunday of Shukla Paksha, by chanting its Beej Mantra “ॐ ह्रां ह्रीं ह्रौं सः सूर्याय नमः.” 108 times
stones.Diamond: Diamond should be worn on the right hand ring finger with its weight more than 1.4 carat solitaire. It should be worn in gold or silver. The gemstone must be worn on a Friday of Shukla Paksha, by chanting its Beej Mantra “ॐ द्रां द्रीं द्रौं सः शुक्राय नमः.” 108 times.
stones.Green Emerald: Green Emerald (Panna) should be worn on the right hand little finger, with its weight calculated as Ratti = Body Weight/10. It should be worn in gold or silver. The gemstone must be worn on a Wednesday of Shukla Paksha, by chanting its Beej Mantra “ॐ ब्रां ब्रीं ब्रौं सः बुधाय नमः.” 108 times.
stones.Pearl: The Moti should be worn on the right hand little finger, with its weight calculated as Ratti = Body Weight/10. It should be worn in silver. The gemstone must be worn on a Monday of Shukla Paksha, by chanting its Beej Mantra “ॐ श्रां श्रीं श्रौं सः चन्द्रमसे नमः.” 108 times.
stones.Red Coral: The moonga should be worn on the right hand ring finger, with its weight calculated as Ratti = Body Weight/10. It should be worn in copper or gold. The gemstone must be worn on a Tuesday of Shukla Paksha, by chanting its Beej Mantra “ॐ क्रां क्रीं क्रौं सः भौमाय नमः.” 108 times.

process: The process begins the evening before wearing it, when the stone has to be worn, an evening before it should be immersed in panchamrit, a mixture of milk, curd, ghee, honey, and sugar and kept at the pooja place of the house. The next morning, after bathing, take the gemstone out of the panchamrit and wash it with Ganga jal. Then offer your usual prayers, and after that activate the stone by chanting its Beej Mantra 108 times, after which it becomes ready to wear. Gemstones meant for lifelong use should be replaced every five years as their potency decreases.
